summary: Sandbach United had a tough pre-season friendly against St Helens, with the visitors' clinical finishing making the difference in a closely contested match. The Ramblers are gearing up for the 2026/27 season which kicks off in just one week, and they've made some exciting new signings plus welcomed back a returning player to bolster the squad. With three brand new kits on display this season, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship partners to support their promotion push.
